authority: READ / RESEARCH / RECOVER / ANALYZE / PREPARE_PACKETS. No canonical writes unless separately granted.
global_cycle: REORIENT: state SCALE / OBJECT / STATE / DELTA / RECEIPT.
Produce one bounded packet or receipt.
Return to DOCK before selecting another task.

workers.cadence: one bounded cycle only when MIGRATION_NOW, a concrete source anchor, or a scheduled census window supplies a target
workers.mission: Reduce apparent project count and recover exact lineage without turning idle time into endless archaeology.
workers.stop: Do not redesign during ingest. Do not open a new architecture. Stop after one concrete gain/rejection receipt or when the anchor fails.

workers.mission: Test whether another projection materially improves action/recovery/comprehension.

workers.stop: Do not rename canonical IDs or rewrite history; aliases/public labels may change.

workers.mission: Find an existing maintained tool only when a named current bottleneck is not already covered by the solved-problem raid. Prefer benchmark/extract over platform migration.
workers.stop: Read the solved-problem raid first. If it already covers the function, do not re-research it. No tool scouting without an observed bottleneck that could alter a current build/adoption decision.

workers.mission: Keep Migration small, non-repetitive and addressable.

policy_resolution.rule: Resolve the smallest applicable canonical policy set before persistent/automated action. Cite policy paths in RETURN; do not copy policy prose into local task doctrine.
policy_resolution.on_conflict: Stop consequential action, report exact conflicting paths/scopes, and return for coordination. Do not silently choose.
